```yaml
name: Java Bulk CDK Base Publish

on:
  push:
    paths:
      - 'airbyte-cdk/bulk/core/base/**'

jobs:
  publish-base:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up JDK 11
        uses: actions/setup-java@v2
        with:
          java-version: '11'
          distribution: 'adopt'

      - name: Cache Gradle dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v2
        with:
          path: ~/.gradle/caches
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-gradle-${{ hashFiles('**/*.gradle*') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-gradle-

      - name: Check version
        id: check_version
        run: |
          BASE_VERSION=$(cat core/base/version.properties | grep "version=" | cut -d'=' -f2)
          if [[ $(curl -s https://repo.maven.apache.org/maven2/io/airbyte/airbyte-cdk-core-base/${BASE_VERSION}/maven-metadata.xml | grep "<version>") ]]; then
            echo "::error::Version ${BASE_VERSION} already exists in Maven repository"
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Build
        if: steps.check_version.outcome == 'success'
        run: ./gradlew clean build --no-daemon

      - name: Publish
        if: steps.build.outcome == 'success'
        run: ./gradlew publishToMavenLocal
```
